import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Matrix {
        int[][] A;

        Matrix() {}

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            A = new int[n][m];
        }

        Matrix(int n) {
            A = new int[n][n];
        }

        int height() {
            return A.length;
        }

        int width() {
            return A[0].length;
        }

        int[] operator[](int k) {
            return A[k];
        }

        static Matrix I(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            return mat;
        }

        Matrix operator+=(Matrix B) {
            int n = height();
            int m = width();
            assert (n == B.height() && m == B.width());
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    A[i][j] = (A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % 1000000007;
            return this;
        }

        Matrix operator-=(Matrix B) {
            int n = height();
            int m = width();
            assert (n == B.height() && m == B.width());
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    A[i][j] = (A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + 1000000007) % 1000000007;
            return this;
        }

        Matrix operator*=(Matrix B) {
            int n = height();
            int m = B.width();
            int p = width();
            assert (p == B.height());
            int[][] C = new int[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++)
                        C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + A[i][k] * B.A[k][j]) % 1000000007;
            A = C;
            return this;
        }

        Matrix operator^=(long k) {
            Matrix B = Matrix.I(height());
            while (k > 0) {
                if (k % 2 == 1) B = B * this;
                this = this * this;
                k /= 2;
            }
            A = B.A;
            return this;
        }

        Matrix operator+(Matrix B) {
            return (Matrix) (this + B);
        }

        Matrix operator-(Matrix B) {
            return (Matrix) (this - B);
        }

        Matrix operator*(Matrix B) {
            return (Matrix) (this * B);
        }

        Matrix operator^(long k) {
            return (Matrix) (this ^ k);
        }

        public String toString() {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            int n = height();
            int m = width();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                sb.append("[");
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    sb.append(A[i][j]);
                    if (j + 1 == m) sb.append("]\n");
                    else sb.append(",");
                }
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }

        int determinant() {
            Matrix B = (Matrix) (this.clone());
            int ret = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < width(); i++) {
                int idx = -1;
                for (int j = i; j < width(); j++) {
                    if (B.A[j][i] != 0) idx = j;
                }
                if (idx == -1) return 0;
                if (i != idx) {
                    ret *= -1;
                    int[] temp = B.A[i];
                    B.A[i] = B.A[idx];
                    B.A[idx] = temp;
                }
                ret *= B.A[i][i];
                int vv = B.A[i][i];
                for (int j = 0; j < width(); j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] /= vv;
                }
                for (int j = i + 1; j < width(); j++) {
                    int a = B.A[j][i];
                    for (int k = 0; k < width(); k++) {
                        B.A[j][k] -= B.A[i][k] * a;
                    }
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }

        void rot() {
            Matrix B = new Matrix(A.length);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] = A[(i + K - 1) % K][(j + K - 1) % K];
                }
                B.A[i][K] = A[(i + K - 1) % K][K];
                B.A[K][i] = A[K][(i + K - 1) % K];
                B.A[K][K] = A[K][K];
            }
            A = B.A;
        }
    }

    static long beki(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0) return 1;
        long ret = beki(a, b / 2);
        ret = ret * ret;
        if (b % 2 == 1) ret *= a;
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[70][35];
        int INDEX = 0;
        int copy = N;
        while (copy >= K) {
            INDEX++;
            copy /= K;
        }
        mat[0][0] = Matrix.I(K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < K + 1; i++) mat[0][0][0][i] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            mat[0][i] = mat[0][i - 1];
            mat[0][i].rot();
        }
        for (int index = 1; index <= INDEX; index++) {
            mat[index][0] = mat[index - 1][0];
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][0] = mat[index - 1][i] * mat[index][0];
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][i] = mat[index][i - 1];
                mat[index][i].rot();
            }
        }
        Matrix ans = new Matrix(K + 1, 1);
        ans[K][0] = 1;
        int used = 0;
        while (INDEX >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
                if (beki(K, INDEX) <= N) {
                    N -= beki(K, INDEX);
                    ans = mat[INDEX][used] * ans;
                    used++;
                    used %= K;
                } else break;
            }
            INDEX--;
        }
        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; i++) {
            val += ans.A[i][0];
            val %= 1000000007;
        }
        System.out.println(val);
    }
}
